title: North Korea's hotel of doom
caption:
The world's tallest hotel has 105 floors, 330 metres and exactly zero guests. 🏨
The Ryugyong Hotel's concrete shell stood unfinished for decades; a glass skin and outside lights came later, but the inside never opened.
Would you book a room?
sources: Wikipedia, Ryugyong Hotel (construction began 1987; 105 storeys, 330 m; work halted in 1992; glass cladding added 2008-2011; LED lights on the exterior from 2018; never opened to guests)
